      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies TxIndex methods in src/index/txindex.cpp (+41/-21) to throw on block data I/O failures and database corruption.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "TxIndex previously returned empty results on database read failures and corruption, causing callers to mistake index errors for missing transactions. Raising an explicit error prevents silent false negatives and ensures index and system corruption are surfaced immediately rather than masked."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies getrawtransaction error handling in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and node::GetTransaction.",

      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Calls to getrawtransaction and REST endpoints misreported disk read failures as missing transactions ('No such transaction found in the provided block'). Differentiating internal read and corruption errors from absent transactions stops callers from receiving misleading status codes on hardware or block file errors."
    },
